people.name: Jesus
people.line: The Son of God and Savior of the world.

translations.web: Jesus answered, “This man didn’t sin, nor did his parents; but, that the works of God might be revealed in him.
translations.bsb: Jesus answered, “Neither this man nor his parents sinned, but this happened so that the works of God would be displayed in him.
translations.kjv: Jesus answered, Neither hath this man sinned, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
translations.asv: Jesus answered, Neither did this man sin, nor his parents: but that the works of God should be made manifest in him.
